text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — final QA on pricing page experiments. Need sign-off on FAQ copy, tier names, and the estimator microcopy before I lock the launch post. Can we confirm lead routing and webinar follow-ups?

Liam O'Sullivan: Yep — routing plan: calculator leads -> webhook /leads/pricing-calc -> SFDC queue 'marketing-pricing'. Webinar regs -> 'mql_webinar' + tag 'webinar-apr'. I can push the mapping tonight. 

Amanda Park: Tier names feedback: I prefer 'Starter / Business / Enterprise' over ambiguous 'Scale' variants. Cleaner for marketing pages and CTAs. :white_check_mark:

Josh Rivera: Calculator UI copy looks fine but add a small tooltip: "Assumes pay-as-you-go unless committed discounts selected". Also propose CTA A/B: 'Estimate your monthly bill' vs 'See pricing' — test on 50/50.

Elena Gomez: If routing changes, I'll need the final field map to update the lead mapping sheet + SFDC rules. @Liam remind me which param carries 'estimated_tokens' so we can segment later.

Liam O'Sullivan: snippet for endpoint and sample payload:```json
{
  "source":"pricing_calculator",
  "email":"{{email}}",
  "est_monthly_tokens": 120000,
  "tier_interest":"Business",
  "ref":"/pricing"
}
```Use field est_monthly_tokens for segmentation.

Maya Chen: I'll update the FAQ draft tonight. Key Qs: "How accurate is the estimator?" (answer: estimate only, for planning; sales outreach for firm quotes), "What happens after I submit?" (answer: auto-email + rep outreach if > threshold). Draft here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pricing-faq-draft — feedback welcome.

Amanda Park: For the launch narrative — suggest a 2-slide benchmark story: (1) cost/latency tradeoff vs baseline, (2) three customer archetypes showing expected monthly bill changes. Plan webinar to highlight runtime demo + cost controls. Want infra eng to co-present.

docs-bot: docs-deploy: pricing-faq.md pushed to staging at 2024-03-21T22:10:00Z — review link: https://staging.redwood/docs/pricing-faq

Josh Rivera: For inbound routing, recommend a separate nurturing flow for calc leads with cadence: immediate email (estimate summary), 3-day product tips, 7-day case study. Tag as 'calc_lead' so ops can see conversion.

Maya Chen: Great — next steps: Amanda to finalize tier copy by EOD, Liam to ship webhook config, Elena to update SFDC mapping, Josh to author nurture templates. I'll schedule launch post once all checkboxes green. :rocket:
